body:
Decided with the maintainer on 2026-09-26. A server admin sets one short message that every client
shows: on the login page and at the top of the overview. Use cases: a scheduled downtime, "this
server is full, registration is closed, please use another", and the like.

## Wire (additive; PROTOCOL_VERSION stays 3)

* The message is one more server setting beside `allow_registration`, in the existing
  `server_settings` store: key `message`, a string, empty = none. It survives restarts.
* `GET /admin/server-settings` → adds `"message": "<text>"` (`""` when none).
  `PUT /admin/server-settings` → accepts `"message"` beside `"allow_registration"`, with exactly
  the same auth and step-up rules the endpoint has today (keep them; do not invent new ones).
  Setting `""` clears it. Audit event `admin.message_set` with the length only (never the text),
  `admin.message_cleared`.
* Validation, server-side, `422 invalid_message`: after trimming, at most 200 characters; no
  `\n`, `\r` or other control characters (Unicode category Cc). Anything else is allowed, links
  included: the rule is only that clients never make it clickable.
* `GET /registration-status` → adds `"message": "<text>" | null` (null when none). Unauthenticated,
  as today; the login page shows it.
* `POST /sync` response → adds top-level `"server_message": "<text>" | null` on every response,
  so a logged-in client refreshes it with each sync and no new poll exists. Old clients ignore
  the field (both decode leniently; verified).
* `docs/wire-contract.md`: the three endpoint sections, the settings key, the error table row for
  `invalid_message`, and one sentence in "Protocol version" that this is an additive change.
  Error code into `web/src/i18n/apiErrors.ts` and Android `ui/ErrorText.kt` ("The message must be
  one line of at most 200 characters.").

## Clients (same wording and behaviour)

* **Login page**: once the server address is confirmed and `/registration-status` has answered,
  the message shows as a slim neutral line under the server field, in the "info" style, next to
  where "registration is closed" appears today. Plain text: no auto-linking, nothing tappable.
* **Overview**: a slim neutral banner at the top, above the lists (web and Android one-account);
  Android with several accounts shows each server's message at the top of that account's
  section, under its heading. Not dismissable. Plain text, no auto-linking. Info style, distinct
  from the error/attention banners.
* **Android** keeps the last message per account (`accounts.serverMessage`, schema 11 with a
  trivial add-column migration and its test) so it shows offline; `SyncEngine` stores it from
  every `/sync` response; the login flow shows the registration-status one without storing.
  **Web** keeps it in the sync store (memory) and, like other per-tab conveniences, may cache it
  in safeStorage; the login page uses the registration-status answer directly.
* **Admin console, both clients**: a "Server message" field showing the current text, with Save
  and Clear (Clear = save ""), under the registration toggle, using the same request the toggle
  uses. Inline validation mirrors the server rule (one line, ≤ 200 characters) with the same
  sentence as the error code's, before anything is sent; the server's 422 shows the same text.
* Strings in nine locales on each client, identical English: field label "Server message",
  helper "One line, shown to everyone on the login page and above their lists.", buttons reuse
  "Save" and a "Clear" (reuse if one exists).
* Tests: server (validation, persistence across restart, audit, the two read endpoints, the sync
  field); web (login line, overview banner, admin field, error code); Android (migration 10→11,
  SyncEngine stores per account, login line, overview banner per section, admin field, no
  clickable spans — assert the Text has no LinkAnnotation).
title: Server message: a one-line notice every client shows on the login page and above the overview, set from the admin console
